patches.name: Alert distances
patches.description: How early each alert is announced.

patches.name: All moods
patches.description: Unlocks every mood, beta ones too.

patches.name: Allow high refresh rate
patches.description: Lets Waze select supported phone display modes up to an adjustable ceiling. Does not guarantee rendering FPS.

options.description: 60 to 120 Hz. Editable in Customization. Restart Waze after changing it; higher rates may use more power.

patches.name: Auto zoom
patches.description: Keeps your auto-zoom choice after settings sync. Choose off, on or by speed.

options.description: Also editable in Customization after patching.

patches.name: Average speed zone bar
patches.description: Bar with progress and your average speed in an average speed zone. Off until switched on.

patches.name: Bigger alert pins
patches.description: Bigger alert pins on the map.

patches.name: Bigger speedometer
patches.description: Bigger speedometer and speed limit digits.

options.description: The mph or km/h label. Waze: 12.

patches.name: Broadcast navigation data
patches.description: Broadcasts current speed, road limits, road alerts and approaching/active average-speed zones locally, including in the background. Includes a silent startup and health API for patched Maps/Vela; no overlay required.

options.description: Optional target app package. Blank broadcasts to running compatible local receivers.

patches.name: Car alerts as notifications
patches.description: Uses car notifications for supported Waze alerts. Availability depends on the car host.

patches.name: Car reconnect grace period
patches.description: Defers Android Auto projection shutdown for brief disconnections. Leaves the phone background timeout unchanged.

options.description: 1 to 10 minutes. Also editable in Customization; restart Waze/reconnect to apply.

patches.name: Car traffic meter
patches.description: Enables the traffic meter on supported car navigation screens.

patches.name: Change app name and icon
patches.description: Sets the launcher and app-switcher name, with a choice of launcher icon styles on light or dark backgrounds.

options.description: Shown on the home screen and Android Auto.
Waze's own icon, or one of five mascot styles on a light or dark background.

patches.name: Extra map info
patches.description: Separate switches for an always-visible compass and available toll prices.

options.description: Adds a compass switch in Customization.
Shows prices when supplied with route data. Adds a separate switch in Customization.

patches.name: Flock cameras
patches.description: Chime when a Flock camera is ahead, from OpenStreetMap. No map pins or routing. Off until switched on.

patches.name: Full black
patches.description: True black dark mode for AMOLED screens.

options.description: The night map in black too.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored pins, stop ads and ad tracking.

patches.name: Hide recent destinations
patches.description: Hides the native recent-destination list. Waze still stores the history; favorites and future events stay available.

patches.name: Lane guidance
patches.description: Enables lane guidance and optional straight-ahead hints. Keeps your Waze lane-guidance preference.

options.description: Adds a separate switch in Customization. Lane data must be available for the road.

patches.name: Map skin
patches.description: Bigger map labels, a wider arrow and a warm day background.

patches.name: Native camera and hazard controls
patches.description: Keeps selected Waze camera and crosswalk alerts enabled, including map and notification gates. Needs Waze data.

patches.name: Navigation distances
patches.description: Android Auto heads-up distances and the traffic bar threshold.

patches.name: No AI reporting
patches.description: Turns off Gemini voice reporting.

patches.name: No Google Assistant
patches.description: Removes Google Assistant from Waze.

patches.name: Open without device location
patches.description: Opens Waze with location off and uses it once it is on. Still needs the location permission.

patches.name: Remove permissions
patches.description: Removes contacts, calendar, phone, camera and advertising ID access.

patches.name: Remove sign-in prompts
patches.description: Stops Waze's own reminder to register your account.

patches.name: Remove telemetry
patches.description: No crash reports, usage stats or performance data. Traffic reporting stays.

patches.name: Report speed limit
patches.description: Lets you correct speed limits from the speedometer (unverified).

patches.name: Share Waze Alerts with external applications
patches.description: Shares Waze's road alerts with patched apps on this phone, such as Ungoogled Maps and Vela Maps. Waze must be signed in and open.

patches.name: Skip consent screens
patches.description: Answers privacy and terms consent silently and declines ad personalization without showing a screen.

patches.name: SoundCloud in Waze
patches.description: Adds SoundCloud to Waze's built-in audio player. Show list displays the signed-in Feed and playable mixes, not the personal Library. SoundCloud Home recommendations are not included.

patches.name: Speed bump controls
patches.description: Independent controls to show speed bumps on the map and silence their on-route warnings.

options.description: Adds Show speed bumps on map in Customization.
Adds a separate suppression switch; does not hide map markers.

patches.name: Speed camera alerts
patches.description: Chime when a speed camera is ahead, from OpenStreetMap, in any country. No map pins or routing. Off until switched on.

patches.name: Speed camera sound at any speed
patches.description: Plays the camera sound even when you are not speeding.

patches.name: Speed cameras everywhere
patches.description: Camera and police alerts in every country. Camera warnings are illegal in some.

patches.name: Speed limit controls
patches.description: Keeps the speed limit visible and enables limit-drop warnings with an editable distance.

options.description: Adds a separate visibility switch. Reporting and sign style stay independent.
Adds a separate warning switch in Customization.
0 to 20000 metres. Also editable in Customization after patching.

patches.name: Speed limit sign
patches.description: One speed limit sign style in every country.

patches.name: Stay awake in the background
patches.description: Keeps Waze running without a route so its alerts keep reaching Maps. Uses more battery.

patches.name: Support Gearslip
patches.description: Accepts Gearslip and DriveDeck as car hosts by package name, whichever key signed them, so a patched Gearslip keeps working. Other hosts keep Android Auto host validation.

patches.name: Use Android system TTS for navigation
patches.description: Adds a system TTS control to Settings and replaces online navigation chunks using Android's default engine.

patches.name: YT Music Morphe in Waze
patches.description: Adds YT Music Morphe to Waze's built-in audio player. Show list displays supported Home recommendations and mixes, not your personal Library. Available shelves depend on the installed client.

options.description: Comma separated package names of patched YouTube Music apps. Installed repackaged YouTube Music apps are also detected automatically.
Home section titles separated by |, matching the language used in YT Music. Speed dial is always included. Only sections returned by the installed Morphe client are shown.
